operation.title: Published testbench analysis dispatch
operation.summary: Bind one published schematic testbench artifact by its own digests, derive exactly one single-analysis deck per declared analysis, dispatch every derived deck through the shared circuit-simulation profile, and return one aggregated evidence envelope.

assertion.statement: Every analysis the digest-bound published testbench declares was dispatched as its own single-analysis deck and produced fresh, structurally valid, interpretable native simulation evidence.
non_goals: This assertion does not state that any circuit performance specification was satisfied.
This assertion does not state that the published schematic is electrically correct, that its topology matches an intent, or that the declared analyses are adequate.
This operation binds no unresolved model, width, or length placeholder; parameter binding belongs to the authoring step that publishes the artifact.
This operation does not evaluate measurements, corners, statistical runs, or any analysis the artifact does not declare.
This operation does not mutate the published artifact, its deck, its view, or any supplied model collateral.

pass.meaning: The artifact was digest-verified, its typed declaration matched the emitted deck's analysis cards, and every declared analysis returned one passing shared circuit-simulation result.
required_evidence: Verified descriptor, netlist, and view digests are retained as bound inputs.
Every derived single-analysis deck is retained by digest.
One complete shared circuit-simulation result envelope is retained per declared analysis.

fail.meaning: Every declared analysis was dispatched and evaluated, and at least one returned a trustworthy native simulation failure while none returned unknown.
required_evidence: The failing analysis, its derived deck digest, and its complete shared circuit-simulation result envelope are retained.

unknown.meaning: The artifact, its digests, its declaration, its required model collateral, the dispatch, or at least one analysis result is insufficient to decide the assertion.
required_evidence: A bounded diagnostic identifies the unbound, mismatched, missing, unstable, or undecided evidence.

configuration_roles.description: One self-contained SPICE model-card file composed into every derived deck. Required whenever the artifact reports simulation_ready=false, which the publisher does for every deck naming a device model.
The installed PDK bound by a reviewed per-PDK binding profile: its corner library, device prefix, parameter spelling, and any Verilog-A modules the simulator must preload.
One Verilog-A (OSDI) module the target PDK requires the simulator to load before any device binds.

semantic_constraints: The target locator must name one canonical absolute regular non-symlink schematic-artifact descriptor.
The descriptor schema, kind, netlistable claim, resolved parameter state, and simulation handoff are validated before any native launch.
The published netlist and view digests are recomputed from the bytes on disk and must equal the digests the descriptor publishes.
The emitted deck's ordered top-level analysis cards must correspond one-to-one with the typed testbench declaration; a disagreement is refused rather than guessed.

A deck carrying an unresolved publisher placeholder is refused. Model collateral arrives either as one self-contained model-card file or as a named PDK bound by a reviewed binding profile; the two are mutually exclusive.

A supplied model-card file must itself be self-contained: an include, library, control, or analysis directive inside it is refused. A PDK bound by a reviewed binding profile is exempt, because its corner library, device prefix, parameter spelling, and Verilog-A preload are declared and every referenced file is content-bound.
Every derived deck carries exactly one top-level analysis card and is dispatched through openada.operation/circuit.simulate/v1alpha2 unchanged.

facts.description: Whether the published netlist and view digests were recomputed and matched.
Declared, dispatched, completed, and passing analysis counts with the publisher's simulation handoff.
Per-analysis derived-deck digest, retained child result, and its independent execution and engineering statuses.
Digest-bound model collateral composed into every derived deck.

integrity: Derived from the digest-verified published deck and retained by digest before launch.
artifact_roles.native_authority: The exact single-analysis deck handed to the simulator.

integrity: One complete unmodified shared circuit-simulation envelope per declared analysis.
artifact_roles.native_authority: The downstream operation's own bounded evidence and status.

integrity: Forwarded unchanged from the dispatched shared circuit-simulation result.
Forwarded unchanged from the dispatched shared circuit-simulation result.

integrity_rules: Recompute the published netlist and view digests from disk before deriving any deck.
Rehash every derived deck after writing it and refuse a deck that does not match its derived digest.
Never report a stronger aggregate execution status than the weakest dispatched analysis.
Never report an aggregate pass while any declared analysis is unknown, and never report fail for an analysis that was not evaluated.
provenance_limitations: Only the published descriptor, deck, view, and explicitly supplied model collateral are content-bound; the publisher's own upstream source and toolchain are trusted as recorded.

A supplied model-card file must be self-contained. A hierarchical vendor PDK entry file is reachable only through a reviewed per-PDK binding profile, which resolves its corner section and preloads its Verilog-A modules; transitive library reads beyond the declared entry point remain bounded provenance.
Each dispatched analysis inherits the bounded provenance limitations of openada.operation/circuit.simulate/v1alpha2.
The aggregate assertion covers only the analyses the artifact declares; it makes no claim about corners, statistical runs, or unauthored analyses.

features.request_effect: Derive and dispatch one single-analysis deck per declared analysis when the published artifact reports simulation_handoff=split_required.
features.conformance_case: Replay one published two-analysis model-free testbench artifact and confirm two derived decks, two retained child envelopes, and one aggregate pass.

features.request_effect: Compose one digest-bound self-contained model-card file into every derived deck so a deck naming device models becomes runnable without an uninspected include chain.
features.conformance_case: Replay one published model-naming testbench artifact with and without model collateral and confirm a refusal in the second case.

diagnostics.condition: The descriptor is absent, unreadable, oversized, not JSON, or missing a required published field.
diagnostics.next_action: Publish a complete schematic artifact descriptor and rerun.

diagnostics.condition: A published file does not hash to the digest its descriptor declares.
diagnostics.next_action: Republish the artifact so its digests match its bytes.

diagnostics.condition: The published artifact is not a testbench and declares no analyses.
The artifact reports an unresolved parameter state or its deck carries a publisher placeholder.
diagnostics.next_action: Bind the model, width, and length at authoring time and republish.

diagnostics.condition: The artifact reports simulation_ready=false and no model collateral was supplied.
diagnostics.next_action: Supply a self-contained spice-model-library configuration reference, or bind an installed PDK by name.

diagnostics.condition: The supplied model collateral declares an include, library, control, or analysis directive.
diagnostics.next_action: Supply flattened self-contained model cards, or bind an installed PDK by name so its binding profile resolves the library entry point.

diagnostics.condition: The emitted deck's analysis cards do not correspond to the typed testbench declaration.
diagnostics.next_action: Recompile the testbench so its deck and declaration agree.

diagnostics.condition: A declared analysis kind is outside the closed set or unsupported by the selected backend.
diagnostics.next_action: Select a backend covering every declared analysis.

diagnostics.condition: The artifact declares more than one analysis and was dispatched as one deck per analysis.
diagnostics.next_action: None; the split is the operation's declared behavior.

diagnostics.condition: The evidence destination could not be created, written, or content-bound.
diagnostics.next_action: Supply a writable absolute destination and rerun.

semantic_bindings.implementation: Remove every top-level analysis card except one, carry all remaining lines through byte-for-byte, and dispatch each derived deck through the shared circuit-simulation profile.
Insert the verified self-contained model-card text immediately after the deck title line of every derived deck.

native_actions: Recompute the published netlist and view SHA-256 digests and compare them with the descriptor.
Write one derived single-analysis deck per declared analysis into the evidence destination and rehash it.
Invoke openada.operation/circuit.simulate/v1alpha2 once per derived deck and retain its complete envelope.
limitations: Only the closed op, dc, ac, and tran analysis kinds the publisher may declare are dispatchable.
A supplied model-card file must be self-contained. A hierarchical vendor PDK entry file is supported only for a PDK with a reviewed binding profile, selected by name rather than by path.
The operation adds no analysis the artifact does not declare and reinterprets no native convergence result.

semantic_bindings.implementation: Derive the same single-analysis decks and dispatch them through the shared circuit-simulation profile's Xyce mapping.
Insert the verified self-contained model-card text immediately after the deck title line of every derived deck.

native_actions: Recompute the published netlist and view SHA-256 digests and compare them with the descriptor.
Write one derived single-analysis deck per declared analysis into the evidence destination and rehash it.
Invoke openada.operation/circuit.simulate/v1alpha2 once per derived deck and retain its complete envelope.
limitations: The Xyce mapping rejects the operating-point analysis, so a testbench declaring op is refused before launch.
A supplied model-card file must be self-contained. A hierarchical vendor PDK entry file is supported only for a PDK with a reviewed binding profile, selected by name rather than by path.
